description: Saves auto-ordering configuration with the exact WAPI request body for one visible store/channel. Requires HGRApi Header channel / ChannelOAuthId resolved internally, confirmed=true and impactConfirmed=true for supplier credential/configuration changes. Secret fields are redacted in the response.

channelOAuthId.description: ChannelOAuthId returned by hgr_list_channels for the selected visible store.

confirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly requested or confirmed the exact action.

impactConfirmed.description: Must be true after the user explicitly confirmed the concrete high-impact consequences.

name: hgr_save_autoordering_configuration
title: Save Autoordering Configuration
